audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were missing and one was described wrongly. Ring of Frost never appears on the page at all. Frozen Tomb is described as a peel that 'zones your channel', when what it actually does when self-cast is make her untargetable and invulnerable while healing her.
audit.why: Ring of Frost is a 450-range point-blank ROOT on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — that is the whole reason walking up to her is dangerous, and because it is immobilizing crowd control it also breaks Neeko's disguise (Inherent Glamour breaks on receiving immobilizing CC). Frozen Tomb self-cast is the untargetable-dodges-burst and needs-antiheal interaction flagged in the brief: spells spent into it hit nothing and it heals her back.
audit.corrected: Ring of Frost written into cooldowns, trading, early and the don'ts, with the disguise-break stated; Frozen Tomb rewritten as untargetable, invulnerable and healing, with Oblivion Orb added to itemization.
sources: enemyKit W and R Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was generic and named no Lissandra timing.

notes: Ring of Frost was absent from the whole page despite being a 450-range root on 8-10 seconds — and because it is immobilizing CC it breaks Neeko's disguise, which is stated now. Frozen Tomb was described as zoning your channel; Riot's text says self-cast it makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing her, which is both flagged missing interactions (untargetable-dodges-burst, needs-antiheal) and is now written with Oblivion Orb in itemization. The suspectName 'Frozen Tombs' in wants.foe[1] was a real error and is fixed. All seven chart rows disagreed between layers (sides all 'Skill'; win[N] and packet levelChart both Neeko x3, Lissandra x2, Neeko x2) — sides moved to match win[N] with every why rewritten in the same proposal. Ratings, tone and diff left alone: EVEN at 5.5/10 fits a 48.44% win rate over 192 games. I also removed a 'triple-bloom' claim from dosFull[2].t — Riot's text for Blooming Burst says the seed blooms again on hitting a champion or killing a unit, which does not support three blooms; that phrasing appears across other Neeko matchups too and someone should decide the correct wording once, globally. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
